original_problem_scope_before: Known/repository-positive scope included Ramanujan and long-range expanders, pre-entropic LRE variants, historical Cartesian and synchronous tensor products, line graphs, truncations, finite-fiber/twisted extensions, and P26 graph squares.
original_problem_scope_after: Adds strong graph squares G_n boxtimes G_n of fixed-degree vertex-transitive c-long-range expanders with a uniform lower spectral edge; these are vertex-transitive spectral expanders, fail every fixed long-range-expansion constant, and have Salez-convention continuous-time cutoff with O(sqrt(log |V|)) window. Nonbipartite Ramanujan Cayley bases give an explicit source-valid family.
new_cutoff_center: For d-regular base size n, q=d-1: T_n = [d(d+2)/((d+1)(d-2))] log_q n = [d(d+2)/(2(d+1)(d-2))] log_q |V(H_n)|.
mechanism_progress: Exact transitivity-specific NBRW collision trace identity: chi^2(K_r(x,.),uniform) = sum_{i=2}^n p_r(lambda_i)^2 for every start x. This removes the prior start/orbit-sector collision obstruction and yields a complete spectral-trace sufficient criterion for O(sqrt(log n)) continuous-time cutoff.
remaining_obstruction: Prove a polylogarithmic NBRW spectral-trace bound at the entropic radius from vertex transitivity plus ordinary spectral expansion alone, or find a different equivariant transport kernel when that trace condition fails. Long-range expansion is not assumed equivalent to spectral expansion.
review_status: CANDIDATE_FULL for the two restricted theorems, pending later independent review; PARTIAL for T08
